tech.summary: Anthropic ke shares Friday premarket mein 6% gir gaye — Thursday ko $111.50 par khulne ke baad close $97 par hua, opening se 13% neeche. Fully diluted valuation ab bhi taqreeban $1.7 trillion hai, lekin analysts kehte hain 40x sales ki valuation par sawal uth rahe hain. Retail investors ne pehle din $772 million ke shares trade kiye — 2012 se kisi bhi IPO debut ka record. Ab sab ki nazar OpenAI par hai, jo agle saal listing ki taraf dekh raha hai.
tech.title: Anthropic ka IPO pehle din hi phisla — $111.50 se $97, phir Friday ko 6% aur gira

tech.summary: Sadr Donald Trump ne Friday ko elaan kiya ke America un companies ko penalize karega jo data centers mulk se bahar banati hain — 'We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country.' Data centers AI boom ki reedh ki haddi hain, aur aisi pabandi global AI infrastructure ki cost aur planning dono badal sakti hai. Trump ne Asia ke doray ke baad White House mein ye baat AI par guftagu ke doran kahi.
tech.title: Trump: bahar data center banane wali US companies par 'tremendous tax' lagega

tech.summary: SpaceX ne Thursday ko $32 billion ke bonds bech kar Nvidia AI chips khareedne ke liye financing ki — sab se bara hissa $25.2 billion, 8.259% yield par, jab ke aam high-grade bonds par average yield sirf 5.95% thi. Ye $40 billion se zyada ki financing ka hissa hai, jis mein Nvidia ke naye Rubin chips taqreeban paanch saal ke liye lease par liye jayenge. Lenders ne to ye tak chaaha ke chips ko orbit mein bhejne par pabandi lage — warna default par un ki recovery mushkil ho jayegi.
tech.title: SpaceX ne Nvidia chips ke liye $32 billion ka qarz liya — 8% se zyada yield par

tech.summary: CrowdStrike rival cybersecurity company Zscaler ko khareedne ki baat-cheet kar raha hai — Bloomberg ne pehle report kiya, Reuters ne apne source se confirm kiya. Mil kar dono ki combined market value taqreeban $265 billion banegi, jo cyber sector ki sab se bari deals mein se aik hogi. Khabar ke baad Zscaler ke shares after-hours mein 17% upar aur CrowdStrike 8.5% neeche gaye. Abhi koi deal pakki nahi — baat-cheet khatam bhi ho sakti hai.
tech.title: CrowdStrike Zscaler ko khareedne ki baat-cheet mein — $265 billion ka cyber giant ban sakta hai

tech.summary: Intuit ne email marketing platform Mailchimp ko Bending Spoons ko $3.68 billion mein bechne ka agreement kar liya — $3.31 billion cash aur $368 million Bending Spoons ke shares. Intuit ne Mailchimp 2021 mein taqreeban $12 billion mein khareeda tha, matlab aaj ki qeemat us ka sirf 30% hai. Deal early 2027 mein close hone ki umeed hai, aur Intuit ka kehna hai ke woh ab chhote businesses ke liye AI products par focus karega aur cash se apne shares wapas khareedega.
tech.title: Intuit ne Mailchimp $3.68 billion mein bech diya — 2021 mein $12 billion mein khareeda tha

tech.summary: Anthropic ke mathematician Levent Alpöge ne Friday ko daawa kiya ke unhon ne Claude ke saath mil kar Riemann Hypothesis ka proof dhoond liya hai — woh masla jo 1859 se hal nahi hua aur jis par $1 million ka Millennium Prize hai. Proof Lean programming language mein formalize kar ke release kiya gaya hai, lekin abhi independent verification baqi hai. Ussi din aik aur daawa bhi aaya — Stanford ke Alessandro Masullo ne baghair AI ke Generalized Riemann Hypothesis ka draft diya. Experts kehte hain ke Lean files compile hona hi pehla imtihan hai.
tech.title: Claude ne Riemann Hypothesis hal karne ka daawa — 167 saal purana maths ka sab se bara masla

pakistan.summary: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari ne Friday ko Karachi mein kaha ke mulk ki ma'ashi haalat tareekh ki badtareen hai, aur PM Shehbaz Sharif ki koshishon ko unhi ke cabinet ke wazir apne siyasi agenda se distract kar rahe hain. Unhon ne dua ki ke Shehbaz pehle muntakhib PM banen jo 5 saal ki muddat mukammal karen, aur Imran Khan aur Maulana Fazlur Rehman se baat-cheet ka mutalba kiya. Hukumat aur PTI dono naye soobon par referendum ke haq mein nazar aaye.
pakistan.title: Bilawal ne PM ko 'distractions' se khabardar kar diya — 'maeeshat tareekh ki badtareen haalat mein'

pakistan.summary: Economic Coordination Committee ne Friday ko aik aur 416,000 metric tonnes cheeni export karne ki ijazat de di — chaar mah mein teesri dafa, is season ka total 724,000 tonnes ho gaya. Summary mutalqa wazarton mein circulate kiye baghair approve hui, aur IMF ki shart — cheeni sector ki mukammal deregulation — abhi tak poori nahi hui. ECC ne SMEs ke liye Rs50 billion ke concessional export loans ki shartein bhi naram kar di.
pakistan.title: ECC ne 416,000 tonnes cheeni export ki ijazat de di — IMF ki deregulation shart phir poori na hui

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne Rawalpindi mein doosra Test 8 wickets se jeet kar series 1-0 se apne naam kar li — WTC 2025-27 cycle mein pehli series jeet, aur do saal mein pehli Test series jeet. 90 runs ka target sirf 13 overs mein poora hua — Aamer Jamal 34 not out aur Azan Awais 32 not out. Mohammad Abbas ne dono innings mein 3-3 wickets li aur Player of the Match aur Player of the Series dono bane.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne Sri Lanka ko 8 wickets se hara kar Test series 1-0 se jeet li

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Asia Cup Blind T20 Cricket Tournament ke champion ban gaye — Dhaka mein India ke khilaf final baarish ki wajah se wash out ho gaya, aur match referee ne Clause 27 ke tehet Pakistan ko title de diya. Pakistan ne league mein Sri Lanka, Bangladesh aur India teeno ko hara kar top kiya tha. Indian team ne umpires aur referee se behes ke baad closing ceremony ka boycott kar ke runners-up trophy liye baghair wapas chali gayi.
pakistan.title: Pakistan Blind T20 Asia Cup champions — baarish ne final dhoka diya, India ne taqreeb ka boycott kiya

pakistan.summary: Deputy PM Ishaq Dar ne Friday ko Karachi port par Turkish seismic research vessel Oruç Reis ki aamad ki taqreeb mein kaha ke Pakistan ke natural resources — minerals, hydrocarbons, gemstones aur rare earth — ki qeemat 'most conservative estimate' par $8 se $10 trillion hai, jab ke mulk ka kul external debt taqreeban $130 billion hai. Jahaz Indus aur Makran offshore basins mein do mah tak 3D seismic survey karega, aur drilling ka hadaf Q4 2027 hai.
pakistan.title: Dar: Pakistan ke natural resources $8-10 trillion ke — qarz $130 billion ke muqable mein kuch nahi

pakistan.summary: Hukumat ne Friday ko petrol ki qeemat Re1 kam kar ke Rs322 per litre aur high-speed diesel Rs2 barha kar Rs357 per litre kar di — nayi qeematein 21 se 23 November tak lagu rahengi. Petrol par Rs114 aur diesel par Rs100 per litre taxes aur duties ab bhi lag rahe hain. Ye tabdeeli Middle East mein tension ki wajah se international oil markets mein volatility ke doran aayi hai.
pakistan.title: Petrol Re1 sasta, diesel Rs2 mehenga — petrol Rs322, diesel Rs357 per litre
